prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 6 tests (up to +15.4%), though 2 hurt performance (down to -7.7%) and others showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 4 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and most showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) and redesigns (redesign) were helpful, winning 2 tests each (up to +8.7% and +9.0%), though several hurt performance or were rolled back, and others showed no clear effect.
Copy updates (copy) were helpful, winning 2 tests (up to +5.7%), while 7 tests showed no clear effect.
Step reordering (reorder), hints, notifications, and new flows produced no winning tests; step reordering hurt performance in 1 test (-3.8%) and no clear effect was seen in the rest.
Predictions underestimated several large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, -1.5% vs +9.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, new_screen] Pet Cloud Retrieval Status Verification Screen: Adds a dedicated status screen right after sign-in selection that explicitly confirms pre-existing cloud pets are detected and safe prior to entering adoption. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into an account.)
1: [finish, redesign] Centered Interactive Desktop Arrival Redesign for Home Intro: Redesigns the home intro view into a centered spotlight view focusing on instant desktop controls and pet summoning. (why: Overall onboarding completion drops to 44.9% and multiple support emails mention confusion on how to control or summon the pet post-onboarding.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Stage Layout Redesign for Choose Path Companion Overview: Rebuilds the Choose Path screen using a stage layout spotlighting available pet archetypes and adoption options. (why: The choose_path stage has a high mean time of 514s, showing users hesitate when selecting their path.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Companion Wakeup Sequence Flow: Inserts a short interactive wake-up step right before entering the home desktop mode where users trigger their pet's first stretch and greeting action. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not appearing or confusion when finishing onboarding, while completion rate at finish drop to 83.1%.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Data Safety Copy Update on Sign-In Screen: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to directly reassure users that previous companion data will remain intact. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
5: [adoption, layout] Compact Layout Redesign for Pick Friend Screen: Changes the layout of the pick_friend screen to compact mode to fit all pet avatars without scrolling. (why: Adoption conversion step has median 89s and mean 1017s due to decision friction when selecting companions.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Instant Path Selection Tooltip on Choose Path Screen: Adds an inline tooltip clarifying that chosen paths can be changed or expanded later in app settings. (why: Mean time on choose_path is 514s (8.5 mins), indicating high hesitation before choosing a path.)

scores.note: Strong evidence from support and sign-in drop-off; new screens generally perform well despite high dev cost.
Supported by emails and funnel data, but redesigns at finish step have averaged 0.0% lift across 4 tests.
Target step has highest drop-off and latency, but choose_path redesigns historically reduced conversion (-3.2%).
Good problem alignment, but new flows have produced no winning tests in prior experiments.
Addresses high email volume with copy updates that consistently yield positive lift on sign-in (+2.0%).
Addresses high step duration, but layout changes show mixed results with adoption layout slightly negative (-0.8%).
Target step drops 19.1% of users, but hints have shown zero wins and slight drag on choose_path (-0.1%).
